verdict.rationale: Windows ships Copilot integration across Microsoft apps (windows-docs-7) which provides some natural-language command capability, but this is limited to specific apps rather than system-wide OS control, and there's no evidence of natural-language commands operating core OS functions (file management, settings, app control) system-wide. Missing for 10: system-wide natural-language shell/assistant control of the OS, evidence of Copilot handling arbitrary OS-level tasks, independent hands-on validation of natural-language command reliability.
